svg.aria-label: High-contrast presentation circuit: two 6-qubit patch registers in amber, a 2-qubit offset register in purple, and the swap test measured on the ancilla in blue, for a single patch-pair similarity evaluation.

g.text: Pure Swap-Test Siamese QNN — Patch-Pair Comparison Circuit
15 wires · 158 gates · 58 trainable angles · one evaluation scores ONE patch pair
DATA RE-UPLOADING LAYER ×3 (θ = w + pixel · π) + CNOT RING
SHARED θ — ONE weight tensor drives BOTH registers (Siamese)
ancilla-controlled swap of the WHOLE register
⟨Z⟩ = |⟨ψ₀|ψ₁⟩|² — the measured overlap of the two patch states = their similarity score
IDENTICAL patches → swapping changes nothing → perfect interference → ⟨Z⟩ = 1
Every trainable parameter above is a circuit rotation angle — no classical layer anywhere in the model.
